anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades and zero profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Evaluate current trading strategies and market conditions to ensure alignment and effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or misconfigurations.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating insights.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not contributing to trading decisions, which may limit the platform's ability to adapt to market changes.
